summary: Novo Nordisk filed a 6-K disclosing routine buyback transactions under its DKK 15 billion share repurchase programme running from 4 February 2026 through 3 February 2027. The filing details daily transactions from 24 to 28 August 2026, repurchasing 1,050,000 B shares at an average price of DKK 302.13-308.60 per share. Accumulated under the 6 May 2026 sub-programme: 16,220,000 shares for DKK 4.91 billion. Treasury holdings now total 45,019,876 B shares, or 1.0% of share capital. This is a routine capital return update, not an event-driven special situation; watch for continued execution progress against the DKK 15 billion authorization.
